_about: The parity gate's configuration (tests/parity/compare.mjs). `gates` names what slice P2-09 owns: `full` routes are compared whole (landmarks, headings, controls, list fields, row heights at 375); `frame` routes only for the shell the slice draws (frameControls, frameHeadings); `pixelExact` routes also gate on the 2 percent pixel diff. `approved` lists the differences from the baseline that a ruling allows, each with its ruling; nothing else may differ. Later UI slices add their routes to `gates` in their own PR.
